subject: CloudScale: token economics & reserved GPU matching - post-demo notes
messages:
From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@cloudscale.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: CloudScale demo + sizing recap (tokens, $/1M, GPU ask)

Hi Alice — great to meet today, thanks for the demo and for walking through the API flows. Quick written recap so we have a shared starting point and clear next steps.

Call highlights / what we noted
- Expected production traffic: 6–10B tokens / month in steady state, with a burst profile up to ~15B in Q4 if feature launch succeeds.
- Latency SLO target: p90 generation latency < 450ms (token-latency sensitive for chat UX).
- Accuracy: model must match their current LLM baseline for safety filters and entity extraction (they'll share eval prompts).

Pricing / unit-econ targets we discussed
- CloudScale indicated their procurement budget band for inference is roughly $150k–$300k / year initially (pilot + ramp).
- They asked for a target $/1M tokens that would make a Dedicated reservation compelling — ballpark they want to see $/1M in the $600–$900 range to be interesting vs current vendor.

Capacity / GPU considerations (initial thoughts)
- Two possible stacks: latency-optimized H100 cluster vs throughput-focused A100 banding.
- For their 6–10B baseline, rough reserved sizing: 4–6x H100 or 8–12x A100 depending on quantization and batching.
- We flagged fallbacks: hybrid routing to cheaper A100-backed variants for non-latency-critical traffic.

Attachments: I attached a short sizing workbook and a draft mutual action plan (MAP). See Drive link below.

Proposed next steps
1) You to confirm: (a) the pilot token target for Q2, (b) any compliance docs required up front (SOC2 / DPA).
2) We produce a short pricing options table: pilot (3 months), 6-month reserved band, 12-month reserved commitment plus unit-econ per 1M tokens by band and GPU family.
3) Marcus to run a quick benchmark on 1k representative prompts to validate p90 latency on H100 vs A100 with their prompt lengths.

If that aligns, I'll schedule a 30-minute procurement+engineering sync next week to validate budget/phasing and deliver the pricing table.

Thanks — PrIyom
PrIyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Alice Chen <alice@cloudscale.ai>
To: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudscale.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudScale demo + sizing recap (tokens, $/1M, GPU ask)

Thanks PrIyom — summary looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Pilot target: for Q2 we'd like to pilot at ~2B tokens/month for 3 months to validate quality and infra assumptions. If that goes well, we plan a phased ramp to 8B by Q4.
- Procurement budget: our initial ask to finance for the pilot is $45k–$60k (covers pilot & validation). For an annual reserved commitment we can stretch to $200k–$250k if unit-econ per 1M tokens is within the $600–$800 range.
- Latency: 450ms p90 is firm for our chat UX — happy for Marcus to bench with our sample prompts (I'll share a curated file).

Procurement note: We'll need a one-page pricing proposal and a brief on supported encryption / KMS before we can start PO paperwork.

I'll upload our sample prompt set and share procurement lead contact in the next email.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Product, CloudScale AI
alice@cloudscale.ai
[Attachment: cloudscale_sample_prompts.json (JSON)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudScale demo + sizing recap (tokens, $/1M, GPU ask)

Nice recap — a couple of pricing mechanics and a recommended offer to move the deal: 

Pricing/offer guidance (internal)
- Pilot (3 months, 2B tokens/mo): propose a fixed pilot bundle at $55k (covers reserved lanes, prioritized support, 24/7 on-call for launch week). This sits inside their procurement ask.
- Post-pilot reserved commitment tiers (annual):
  * Tier A (latency-first): 6x H100 reserved (~p90 headroom for 8B tokens/mo) — target effective unit-econ: $600–$700 / 1M tokens when amortized over a 12-month commit.
  * Tier B (throughput-first): 12x A100 reserved — target effective unit-econ: $450–$600 / 1M tokens depending on quantization (int8/4bit) and KV cache hit rates.
- We can include a 10% onboarding credit and one month free for 12-month commitments to sweeten the economics if they sign within 30 days.

Operational notes
- Marcus: run latency bench on their sample prompts and include KV-cache scenarios; deliver numbers by Thu EOD.
- PrIyom: prepare a 1-page pricing sheet + KMS support note for procurement (DOC + HubSpot link).

Risks / negotiation levers
- If they insist on $/1M <= $500 with p90 < 450ms, that pushes towards more A100s and higher commit — needs finance sign-off.
- Hybrid routing (H100 for 30% traffic, A100 for background) gives us a negotiation path and keeps headline unit-econ lower.

I'll draft the pilot offer and pricing table; Neha, can you prep the committed-discount language for finance review?

— Vanessa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
